summary: RC6 content-addressed evidence binding, explicit ch00 provenance, specimen-level sensitivity output, and clean worktree are verified. Acceptance fails because RC6 report metadata still points to RC5 artifacts, making report retrieval non-reproducible.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:3-9, tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:3-10, and end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json:3-6 record generation commits and Git-blob hashes.

The RC6 candidate contains corresponding report files under audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report, so the metadata is stale and does not identify the reviewed retained artifacts.

audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:18-29 documents a 225-test run, but the required .venv interpreter is absent in this detached worktree; command .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest ... failed because the executable was not found.

findings.title: RC6 report metadata references RC5 paths
findings.impact: A reproducibility consumer following report_metadata.json can retrieve the wrong release's reports or fail to locate the intended RC6 artifacts. The candidate therefore does not provide a self-consistent report artifact index.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:16-19 contains v571_rc5_candidate paths for biological outputs.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:34-36 contains v571_rc5_candidate paths for quality-control outputs.
RC6 report files are present under audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report as shown by the retained candidate artifact inventory.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate or correct report_metadata.json so every report and numeric-contract path resolves to the RC6 candidate tree, then rerun the report consistency and provenance validation checks under a new audit run.

limitations: The full pytest suite was not rerun because the detached worktree lacks .venv; only focused read-only provenance validation and repository checks were executed.
No full image stack or new image inference was run, per review scope.
recommended_follow_up: Correct the stale RC5 paths in the RC6 report metadata.
Rerun the focused report consistency validator and the complete pytest suite in an environment containing the documented dependencies.
Issue a superseding acceptance audit run after the metadata correction.
